infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HealthFreak needs microphone access to speak with your AI wellness coach.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: HealthFreak uses motion sensor data to track your daily steps, distance, and activity goals.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow HealthFreak to access your microphone for live voice coaching.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow HealthFreak to access your camera to scan meals.

plugins.motionPermission: Allow HealthFreak to access your motion sensors to accurately count your daily steps, distance, and activity goals.
